Website Templates for AI-Powered Apps and Sites | Lovable

name: Lovable
summary: AI platform that builds web and mobile apps, websites and internal tools from natural-language prompts.
description: Lovable is an AI-powered builder: describe a product in plain language and it builds production-grade web and mobile apps, websites and internal tools in real time. Lovable Cloud supplies the backend, database and hosting, with authentication, payments in 200+ countries, Supabase and Shopify integrations, plus an MCP server for AI tools. Template libraries cover apps and websites by category, and guides walk through use cases.
contains: builds web and mobile apps, websites and internal tools from natural-language prompts

Lovable Cloud: built-in backend, database and hosting
integrations: Supabase, Shopify; payments in 200+ countries and territories
MCP server and remote MCP endpoint for AI tools and agents
security: automatic scans and audit logs
guides: app teardowns, comparisons, use cases, inspiration, how-to
